source: Alberta Wildfire, Fire Weather Forecast Zones map (Wildfire Geospatial Intelligence Unit, 2024-05-31), vectorised from the PDF and georeferenced to Alberta 10TM (EPSG:3400) on the provincial corners; max corner error ~0.03%; each zone buffered ~400 m so neighbours overlap (no slivers); the smaller zone wins where they overlap.
